### Download

Download **`rayo.exe`** below and run it. The first time, Rayo offers to install itself (per user, no administrator
rights, with a Start menu entry and an uninstaller) or to run portable. If Rayo is already installed, the palette
command **“Install Rayo (or update it with this version)”** updates it.

> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning the first time:
> click **More info → Run anyway**.

SHA-256 of `rayo.exe`: `{sha256}`

Requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (x64).
